result.instruction: In `axil_regbank`, replace the separate `case (wr_idx)` branches and nested strobe checks for indices 0–2 with shared per-register select terms and per-byte write enables derived from `wr_en`, `wr_idx`, and `wr_strb`. Use those enables to update only the selected register bytes from the matching `wr_data` lanes, preserving each disabled byte. Keep reset values, IRQ and write-count logic, read behavior, handshakes, and all cycle behavior unchanged; this is an area hypothesis, so retain it only if the full gates pass and routed LUTs strictly decrease, or LUTs tie with fewer FFs.
